correctness.rationale: Nonoriented incidence converts adjacency inertia of the m=n+1-edge line graph into inertia of Q(B)-2I with one extra negative. Each cycle interior is a path P_(t-1); exact congruence pivots yield symmetric increments q(t), zero mode z(t), endpoint weights 1,3,-1 for residues 0,1,3 or remove the endpoint for residue 2 via a nonsingular saddle block. Remaining path with d-1 internal vertices is reduced by parity to α+β or [[α,1],[1,β]] or deleted-endpoint paths. Direct independent construction of zero-one line graph matrices, numeric spectra with well-separated tolerance, confirms all three indices for a,b=3..8 and d=1..5 (180 cases); the proof handles the infinite parameter domain and singular branches.
